source_revision: Shopify Admin GraphQL 2026-10; fulfillment-v1; records-v2; questions-v8
identity_rule: Immutable verified shop, keyed connection-scoped fulfillment/order/line/location identities. Stable economic fulfillment record; provider updatedAt observation revision. Same-revision changed content is quarantined.
coverage_rule: Declared order-scoped exact cutoff only; no global or intermediate event-history claim. Preparation without milestones marks a physical handover gap. Separate tracking source required.

retention.basis: No live store grant or merchant retention authorization is available. Synthetic fixtures only verified. Local evidence encryption and 90-day access expiry exist; complete purge/rotation/recovery retention operations remain open.

shipment_id.rule: opaqueIdentity(connection, fulfillments + provider ID); fulfillment-v1; input Fulfillment.id
shipment_id.normalization: Stable connection-scoped keyed UUID; same namespace as order/inventory links. No text-name matching.
shipment_id.missing_behavior: Missing shipment/order/line identity fails import; missing location stays absent and cannot prove a stock-location effect.

order_id.rule: opaqueIdentity(connection, provider order ID); fulfillment-v1; input Order.id
order_id.normalization: Stable connection-scoped keyed UUID; same namespace as order/inventory links. No text-name matching.
order_id.missing_behavior: Missing shipment/order/line identity fails import; missing location stays absent and cannot prove a stock-location effect.

line_id.rule: opaqueIdentity(connection, provider line ID); fulfillment-v1; input Fulfillment.fulfillmentLineItems.nodes[].lineItem.id
line_id.normalization: Stable connection-scoped keyed UUID; same namespace as order/inventory links. No text-name matching.
line_id.missing_behavior: Missing shipment/order/line identity fails import; missing location stays absent and cannot prove a stock-location effect.

location_id.rule: opaqueIdentity(connection, provider location ID); fulfillment-v1; input Fulfillment.location.id
location_id.normalization: Stable connection-scoped keyed UUID; same namespace as order/inventory links. No text-name matching.
location_id.missing_behavior: Missing shipment/order/line identity fails import; missing location stays absent and cannot prove a stock-location effect.

quantity.normalization: Exact nonnegative integer string, never product weight; full nested population and unique line IDs required.
quantity.missing_behavior: Null, negative or malformed quantities quarantine; no default zero.

unit.rule: Shopify fulfillment integer line counts => piece; fulfillment-v1
unit.normalization: No conversion to mass, volume or length.
unit.missing_behavior: Other unit requirements need a supplemental producer.

carrier.reason: This adapter does not yet query carrier/tracking identifiers or parcel-to-line assignments.
carrier.normalization: No guessed carrier, tracking token or per-parcel quantity.
carrier.missing_behavior: Carrier-specific claims and tracking population remain unavailable without a supplemental source.

tracking_number.reason: This adapter does not yet query carrier/tracking identifiers or parcel-to-line assignments.
tracking_number.normalization: No guessed carrier, tracking token or per-parcel quantity.
tracking_number.missing_behavior: Carrier-specific claims and tracking population remain unavailable without a supplemental source.

handover_at.normalization: Explicit timestamp only, after creation and no later than updatedAt/fixed cutoff. No inference from SUCCESS, tracking-number creation or administrative status.
handover_at.missing_behavior: Null stays absent. Preparation without physical timestamps creates fulfillments.handover_confirmation; delivery does not manufacture missing handover time.

delivered_at.normalization: Explicit timestamp only, after creation and no later than updatedAt/fixed cutoff. No inference from SUCCESS, tracking-number creation or administrative status.
delivered_at.missing_behavior: Null stays absent. Preparation without physical timestamps creates fulfillments.handover_confirmation; delivery does not manufacture missing handover time.

state.rule: fulfillment-v1: deliveredAt => delivered; else inTransitAt => handed_over; else CANCELLED => cancelled; SUCCESS => prepared; ERROR/FAILURE => failed
state.normalization: Physical state takes precedence; administrative_status is retained separately. Contradictory milestone order is quarantined.
state.missing_behavior: Preparation/failure is factual but cannot prove carrier handover or complete physical delivery answers.

event_rules.rule: Versioned current fulfillment assertion. Rust records-v2 emits fact for every valid state; movement/reservation only for handed_over or delivered. Stable economic record counted once; no additive stock delta.
No separate discrete event emitted from current snapshots; supplied milestone fields remain in shipment.observed assertions.
event_rules.unsupported_reason: The order/fulfillment snapshot is not an exhaustive intermediate lifecycle event stream; no inferred administrative-to-physical transition.

event_rules.rule: No separate discrete event emitted from current snapshots; supplied milestone fields remain in shipment.observed assertions.
event_rules.unsupported_reason: The order/fulfillment snapshot is not an exhaustive intermediate lifecycle event stream; no inferred administrative-to-physical transition.

event_rules.rule: No separate discrete event emitted from current snapshots; supplied milestone fields remain in shipment.observed assertions.
event_rules.unsupported_reason: The order/fulfillment snapshot is not an exhaustive intermediate lifecycle event stream; no inferred administrative-to-physical transition.

synchronization.initial_import: Immutable date range plus explicitly selected accessible older open/related context. Full fulfillment array count check and nested line pagination before each order is processed.
synchronization.cursor: Fenced durable outer order cursor and fixed cutoff. Nested pages must finish with stable updatedAt; repeated cursors, oversized populations and imprecise counts reject the page.
synchronization.reconciliation: Periodic bounded full selected order enumeration; observed provider revisions append. No physical return or stock increase inferred from cancellation/disappearance.
synchronization.deduplication: Connection/economic fulfillment/provider updatedAt observation ID; fixed replay idempotent; different content at same revision is a conflict. Rust selects each economic record once.
synchronization.freshness: Per-page identity/grants check; successful check, new record, reconciliation, processing and unresolved review remain distinct.

local_standalone.schedule: Default incremental 120 seconds plus 0–10% jitter; reconciliation every six hours.
local_standalone.history_limit: Accessible updated order snapshots and selected older open context; max 100000 orders, 1000 fulfillments/order, 500 lines/fulfillment, 10000 lines/outer page, 2 MiB response. No exhaustive event history.
local_standalone.authentication: Encrypted existing app token or permitted client credentials; verified immutable shop, read_orders/write_orders and applicable read_all_orders; no public callback.
local_standalone.recovery: Durable outer cursor, provider revision idempotence, bounded retries, original-input review retry, journal reconstruction after process restart.
local_standalone.limitations: Missing carrier/tracking and parcel allocation; only supplied physical milestones; non-atomic provider reads; no live proof.
local_standalone.reason: Local outbound-only snapshot capability; unresolved fields remain explicit and may require supplemental producers.

local_gateway.schedule: No gateway/server scheduling in the pilot.
local_gateway.history_limit: No history transport in this mode.
local_gateway.authentication: No public callback, gateway credential or public binding is provisioned.
local_gateway.recovery: No mode runtime to recover; use local_standalone.
local_gateway.limitations: Deferred by baseline-v14 local pilot scope.
local_gateway.reason: Explicit owner-approved P0–P4 scope excludes gateway and public-server implementation.

import_readiness.time_selection: Shared immutable timezone-aware 30-day/calendar/custom/from-now plan. Fixed cutoff bounds query and milestone timestamps.
import_readiness.historical_availability: Accessible order current snapshots plus supplied fulfillment milestone timestamps; not historical states or complete event history. read_all_orders required for older order access.
import_readiness.open_and_related_records: Provider-declared open/unsettled older orders only when selected. Older shipment details require related/open consent; strict new-only excludes them from journal and evidence.
import_readiness.opening_state: No stock or provider-balance opening derived from fulfillment; preparation and dispatch are separate.
import_readiness.progress_accounting: One logical fulfillment with committed/duplicate/skipped/quarantined counters; applied cursor must catch up before finishing. No guessed total/percentage.
import_readiness.readiness_rules: Per-order fixed point coverage only if valid population. Prepared/failed missing milestone marks handover_confirmation; actual malformed records block complete scope. Carrier tracking remains separate.
import_readiness.health_rules: Existing account/grant/reconnect fencing and truthful per-capability check/new/processed/review state. No missing timestamp is silently upgraded to physical handover.
import_readiness.history_expansion: Append new wider plan; stable provider revision replay does not double count. New capability has its own independent incremental/reconciliation chain.
import_readiness.data_handling: Only minimal order header and fulfillment identities/counts/times/line links requested; no addresses/customer names. Individual encrypted evidence; retention/rotation operations not certified here.
